output_list.criticism: The initialSupply is multiplied by 10 ** uint256(decimals) without checking for overflow. If initialSupply is too large, it may cause an integer overflow and result in an incorrect totalSupply.

The balanceOf[_from] -= _value; line may cause an integer overflow if _value is too large. Similarly, the balanceOf[_to] += _value; line may cause an integer overflow if the sum of balanceOf[_to] and _value exceeds the maximum value that can be stored in a uint256 variable.
The _transfer(msg.sender, _to, _value); line may cause an integer overflow if _value is too large.
The _transfer(_from, _to, _value); line may cause an integer overflow if _value is too large.
The totalSupply -= _value; line may cause an integer overflow if the result is too large.
